component.name: Media Player Pro
component.summary: Modern media player with complete frosted glass skin and genuine video enhancement

description.p: Media Player Pro is an advanced, high-performance media player built on top of mpv. It features a non-obstructive frosted glass skin with transparent seekbar, vibrant amber controls, interactive cursor-targeted zoom and dragging, speed dropup selector, and a 3-level genuine video enhancement engine powered by AMD FidelityFX Contrast Adaptive Sharpening (CAS) and deband filtering.
Media Player Pro v1.1 Initial Release:

ul.li: Complete frosted glass skin with transparent seek bar and glowing scrubber
Speed play dropup with 0.25x to 3.0x speed presets
Smooth volume slider with wheel control
Ctrl + Mouse Wheel cursor-centered video zoom and Ctrl + Drag pan
3-level genuine video enhancement engine (Deband + FidelityFX CAS)
3-second inactivity autohide for controls and mouse pointer
